segments.segment_summary: A first-person view from inside a tractor cab shows a person preparing to clear a field. The driver explains the plan to cut down bushes and then operates the tractor's controls.

key_moments.caption: The tractor's mower is seen cutting bushes on the right.
The driver gestures out the window, explaining the plan to clear the area.
The driver operates a joystick to control the mower attachment.
A close-up view of the driver's hand on a red lever.

segments.segment_summary: A view from underneath a red rotary mower shows the blades starting up. The blades go from stationary to spinning at high speed.

key_moments.caption: The mower blades are stationary under the mower deck.
The blades begin to slowly rotate.
The blades accelerate rapidly until they are a blur of motion.

segments.segment_summary: From the tractor cab, the red rotary mower is shown actively cutting down thick bushes and tall grass. The tractor moves forward, clearing a path through the overgrown vegetation.

key_moments.caption: The mower engages and begins shredding tall bushes, throwing debris.
The tractor continues moving forward, with the mower cutting a wide swath through the dense brush.
The mower is shown from a high angle as it continues to pulverize the undergrowth.
